* VERSION y la release que publica el APK firmado by @Jeremaya25 in https://github.com/Jeremaya25/prdrive-app/pull/5
* La huella del certificado, diga como diga apksigner by @Jeremaya25 in https://github.com/Jeremaya25/prdrive-app/pull/6
